description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterMachineType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSerialNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInspectionValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PressButtons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterAdditionalValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Inspection application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InspectionSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskInspectionQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InspectionJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inspection">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ToType</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ToType</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Type_ToSerial</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Type_ToSerial</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Serial_ToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InspectionSplit" name="Begin inspection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Serial_ToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ToAskQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ToPressButtons</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AskInspectionQuestions" name="Ask inspection questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ToAskQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AskQuestions_ToEnterValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInspectionValues" name="Enter inspection values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AskQuestions_ToEnterValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterValues_ToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButtons" name="Press buttons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ToPressButtons</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButtons_ToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Collect values from machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButtons_ToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_ToShow</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowMachineValues" name="Show collected values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_ToShow</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Show_ToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InspectionJoin">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterValues_ToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Show_ToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_ToAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Are additional questions needed?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_ToAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions" name="Ask additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AskAdditional_ToEnterValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAdditionalValues" name="Enter additional values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AskAdditional_ToEnterValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalValues_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Inspection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalValues_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToType" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_ToSerial" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Serial_ToSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToAskQuestions" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit" targetRef="Task_AskInspectionQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskQuestions_ToEnterValues" sourceRef="Task_AskInspectionQuestions" targetRef="Task_EnterInspectionValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterValues_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnterInspectionValues" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToPressButtons" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit" targetRef="Task_PressButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtons_ToCollect" sourceRef="Task_PressButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_ToShow" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Task_ShowMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Show_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ShowMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ToAdditionalQuestions" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsNeeded" name="Additional questions are needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Additional questions are needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="EndEvent_Inspection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskAdditional_ToEnterValues" sourceRef="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_EnterAdditionalValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalValues_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterAdditionalValues" targetRef="EndEvent_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
